causal.assumptions_right: Direction was right: the 2027 hike path was rich relative to cash, and the receive from 3.40 did not need to be abandoned.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Near-term mark-to-market and rank-path variance was underweighted; a correctly signed receive can still print a large interim drawdown and rank shock.
causal.causal_divergence: The shock was mark-to-market path, not a completed 2027 tightening cycle that validated December 2027 at 3.50. Cash stayed 2.30 in the supplied marks; the strip did not realize the priced hike path.
causal.future_implication: Rank is not a sizing signal. Keep the existing 42.5 million receive and do not scale up because the shock reversed.
causal.observed_reality: Rank moved from 2 to 8 with an interim drawdown near 89633 and net near -5787, then rank returned to 2 with positive net. Live H-Z near 3.264 remains below the 3.40 entry and far above cash 2.30.
causal.original_belief: The 2027 CORRA strip overpriced tightening versus a cash rate already at 2.30, so receiving the H-Z pack was the right easing expression.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: The same information would still hold the receive and would still refuse an add on a rank 8-to-2 recovery.

items.no_new_lesson: The rank 2-to-8-to-2 move with an interim drawdown then positive net is bounded ordinary variance around a correctly signed receive; the original process remains sound. Do not add because rank recovered.
items.what_happened_vs_expected: Expected a grind lower in 2027 implieds toward cash. Instead printed a rank 2-to-8 drawdown near 89633 and net near -5787, then recovered to rank 2 and positive net, with live H-Z near 3.264 still only partway from 3.40 toward 2.30.
